FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Late Payments
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Small update to late payments to make them more visible.

patchNoteLines.li: When a bill with a payment is allowed to come due (instead of paying it ahead of time), the player is sent a letter, and the affected settlements gain a small happiness and unrest penalty

additionalNotes.li: Please raise any issues you find on the Github page.
